review.official:
Uika Misumi, the charismatic guitarist-vocalist of
Ave Mujica
, as well as a member of the idol unit
sumimi
. Her hobbies include stargazing. Concern for
Sakiko
also appears to be a forefront preoccupation of hers.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Uika Misumi shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.

With an infectiously bright smile and excellent communication skills, Uika Misumi has fit in well at Rhodes Island. Throughout her time diligently learning the ins-and-outs of working here, Uika has earned the trust of those aboard Rhodes just like the other members of Ave Mujica.

Though she is only in her first year of high school, Uika has already made a successful debut as a member of sumimi, an idol group from her home country. A diligent hard worker, Uika has a wonderful voice and outstanding guitar skills, and also writes her own songs and lyrics. She was scouted for Ave Mujica by Sakiko.
As guitarist-vocalist of Ave Mujica, Uika gives her everything for the band, and her deep love for it is plain for everyone to see.

Uika and Sakiko are childhood friends, which is the reason Uika joined the band. To Uika, Sakiko is more than just a friend; she is someone Uika has always aspired after.
At Rhodes Island, the pair often go up to the deck to watch the stars. Though the night sky of Terra is strange and unfamiliar, when shared with Sakiko, there could be nothing more beautiful to Uika.

We have noticed that Uika seems to put up certain subtle barriers in her interactions with us. It is not that she is not being sincere, but there is a sense that she is intentionally refraining from expressing her opinion. Compared to taking about her own thoughts, she seems to prefer to know about what Sakiko thinks. Uika's feelings toward Sakiko are more than just care or aspiration; there seem to be deeper, darker feelings within.

[Iris's Notes]
Uika has spent her life living in guilt. Though she stands by Sakiko's side, where she has always longed to be, her heart remains trapped in the past. When she feared that telling the truth would destroy the relationship they had, she found herself paralyzed in place.
When Sakiko was in pain, Uika believed that it was her and her lies who caused that pain to Sakiko, and that there was nothing Uika could do to help her. The end result was that she could not be there by Sakiko's side to support her.
One day, Uika will understand that she cannot simply hide her true feelings beneath a perfect smile. There will come a time when she must face herself.
Uika will not remember all that transpired on Terra when she wakes from the dream. But perhaps, a part of her experiences here will stay with her and give her courage—
The courage to face her own sorrow, and to move forward.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: It's funny, Umiri-chan always handles these things for us in Ave Mujica. So here, I have to adjust to managing my own schedule.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Lately, I've been stargazing on the deck with Astesia-san. The stars in Terra's sky are nothing like the ones I know. And when I tell her about our version of astronomy, I can almost see her hanging on every word I say.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Huh? You want me to teach you how to write lyrics...? Wait, Doctor, don't look at my terminal!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The cap and sunglasses? They're for wearing in crowded places, I guess. I work in the performing arts, so I'm kind of... a celebrity? I guess... Wait, Doctor, could it be you're a celebrity on Terra? Heheh. Look, you always have the hood on.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Sora-san always has such a warming effect on people, even when she's not performing. It'd be nice if I could fill everyone with that kind of warmth too.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I'd rather heal us all through music than fight. But... I get it. Becoming stronger is how I stay by Saki-chan's side. That's why I'll always keep putting in the effort, whether here on Terra or back in our world.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Ever since coming to Rhodes Island, we members of Ave Mujica have been spending a lot more time together. Once work's done for the day, we head to the studio to practice... It's kind of like we're all in a school club.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Ave Mujica has always meant so much to Saki-chan. And knowing how she treasures it, I want to protect it for her... I want to keep being Mujica's frontwoman, where I can live, breathe, and embody Mujica's world.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Ending up in a strange place and having to bond with strange people has taken a lot of energy, I'll admit, but getting to learn so much in exchange has all been worth it. I still barely know right from left here, but... I'd like to keep on bonding with the people of Rhodes Island, I think.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Maybe I'll brew some coffee and wait around until the Doctor wakes up?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm Uika... Misumi. Huh? You already heard about me from Saki-chan? How did she describe me, can you tell me?!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Are these all... actual battles you taped?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island's training program is incredible! I feel like it's building every part of me up at once. This is going to make concerts so much easier too!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I don't know when I'll end up home again. Is it really okay for you to pour so much into me, despite that...? Alright, thank you. I'll be sure to work hard to meet your expectations, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: As the squad's frontwoman, I'll lead the way for you all.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I've never been a leader to anyone before, but... I'll serve as a good example for you all!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Be careful out there!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Don't let your guard down. We can definitely win this!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'll help out!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Doctor, I'm trusting you.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: To your curtain fall... an elegy.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: To our victory... a paean.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'm going to sing.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Saki-chan, everyone, I'll protect you!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'll cover you now!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't panic!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: After getting back, let's take a nice hot bath, put on some relaxing music, and really unwind.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We're really getting into sync here!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I just hope nobody got hurt...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's okay, I... I'll always be by your side.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's really nice in here, isn't it!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: One moment, let me put my guitar away... Okay, sorry about that. What do you need, Doctor?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor! Want to go see the stars together?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Back in our world, everyone makes a wish on New Year's. Like this―you put your hands together, and close your eyes... If you have a wish, give it a try. It'll be nice if yours comes true too.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good timing, I was just brewing coffee. Do you want some?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! That tape's got a couple of songs on it. We wrote them for you, and for everyone at Rhodes Island. So even after we return to our old world someday, you'll still have these songs by your side forever.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: When I first got here, I thought I was practically useless. But Rhodes Island is such a warm place, isn't it? It takes in any point of view, it gave me a role that I could play―I guess what I'm saying is, maybe I've earned the right to pride myself, as a member of Rhodes Island?
